list: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list, as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 Nov 2026: 55 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned.

exophase.covers: Official name, description and grade of every trophy
exophase.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

official-description.covers: What the trophy asks for, in PlayStation's own words — the guide below is our reading of it
official-description.name: The trophy's official description

psnprofiles.covers: Official list cross-check and the progress counts PSN tracks (e.g. 42 Shooting Range challenges, 14 drone race locations)
psnprofiles.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order (story, strangers, collectibles, activities, crime, then the 100% cleanup) and this is the last trophy you will hear pop. Sources: Exophase for the official list, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn: play through the intro until the mission completes and it pops. It cannot be missed — the story cannot continue without finishing it. Sources: Exophase for the name and description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Chapter trophies are story progress, not a choice: play the story in order and it cannot be missed. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it is pure story progress: keep playing the main missions in order and it unlocks at the chapter's close. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 3. Chapter trophies follow the story, so there is no special trick: complete the chapter's missions in order and the trophy pops at its end. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 4, the last story chapter before the finale. It pops when the chapter closes, on the way to the final mission. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story — the gold story trophy. It is the natural end of the story path, so it cannot be missed by playing through. Before you start the finale, finish any story-locked side content you still want, since the game may move past it. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Because the description names one specific mission, treat it as a one-shot: keep a manual save from before the mission starts, so a failed run or a skipped objective cannot lock it away. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission. The description names a single mission and no replay is named — keep a manual save from before Breakfast Run in case GTA VI offers no mission replay.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are usually the big set-pieces of a chapter, so go in prepared and keep a manual save from before it starts: if the mission cannot be replayed, there is no second chance at this trophy. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission (a heist). The description names a single mission and no replay is named — keep a manual save from before The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like every named-mission trophy, it is earned by finishing that one mission — save before it, finish it, and the trophy pops at the mission's end. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission. The description names a single mission and no replay is named — keep a manual save from before Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy pops; because no replay is named in the description, keep a manual save from before the mission as insurance. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission. The description names a single mission and no replay is named — keep a manual save from before Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport takedown the name points to. Finish the mission and the trophy pops at its end; save before it, since the description names one mission and no replay. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission at the airport (VCIA). The description names a single mission and no replay is named — keep a manual save from before VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends; as with the other named missions, a manual save from before it is the safe play until mission replay is confirmed for GTA VI. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission. The description names a single mission and no replay is named — keep a manual save from before Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the gold capstone before the platinum. The 100% counter is fed by the story, the stranger strands, the collectibles, the activities and the challenges, so it is really a checklist of everything else in this guide: finish the story, clear the stranger missions, complete the collectible sets and the activity counts, and watch the in-game stats page climb to 100%. It cannot be missed, only left unfinished. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, long airtime and clean landings all feed the counter, and the count is cumulative, so it grows naturally as you drive hard between missions. If you want to grind it, chain stunt jumps and near-miss traffic runs in free roam; there is no time limit and it cannot be missed. PSN tracks the count to 250. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the 250-stunt count.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every kind of activity the game offers, one of each. PSN lists nine activity types — races, drone races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games and the rest of the side activities all count as their own type, so work through the activities menu and try each one once. Nothing here can be missed: every activity stays available after the story. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the nine-type count.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge can be retried as often as you like, so treat it as practice: learn a challenge's targets and timing, then push for the gold threshold — bronze and silver runs do not block you, and nothing here is missable. PSN tracks the count to 42. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the 42-challenge count.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you need a win at every one of them — not 14 wins at the same spot. Races can be retried, so a loss costs nothing but time; work through the locations one by one. PSN tracks the count to 14. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the 14-location count.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race twenty times. Any race type counts, so mix street races, off-road and whatever else the game offers, and tick a new event off each time you win one. Races stay open after the story, so nothing here is missable. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — out-fish him in a head-to-head fishing contest. Fishing challenges can be retried, so if Cal wins the first round, go again with what you learned about the bite timing and the reeling. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game to its end. Any arcade cabinet counts — pick a game, play it through to completion, and the trophy pops. It is a one-off, not a grind, and it stays available after the story. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of Andy's stranger strand. Stranger strands are side questlines that open as you meet their characters around Leonida — follow Andy's strand to its final mission and the trophy pops there. Because it is a named final mission, keep a manual save from before it until mission replay is confirmed. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Final mission of a stranger strand (Andy). The description names a single mission and no replay is named — keep a manual save from before Andy's final mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Work through Kenton's missions as they appear and the trophy pops at the strand's finale. Like the other stranger finales, it names one mission — save before it, just in case it cannot be replayed. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Final mission of a stranger strand (Kenton). The description names a single mission and no replay is named — keep a manual save from before Kenton's final mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of Billy's stranger strand. Follow Billy's strand through its missions to the finale and the trophy pops at the end. Save before the final mission: the description names one mission and no replay is named. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Final mission of a stranger strand (Billy). The description names a single mission and no replay is named — keep a manual save from before Billy's final mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers are the side characters marked around the map — meet one, work through their missions to the end, and that strand counts. Eight finished strands earn the silver; the five named finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of them, so three more strands from other strangers complete the set. Nothing here is missable after the story as long as the strands stay open. PSN tracks the count to 8. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the 8-strand count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of Randy's stranger strand. Work Randy's strand to its finale and the trophy pops there; as with the other stranger finales, keep a manual save from before the final mission until replay is confirmed. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Final mission of a stranger strand (Randy). The description names a single mission and no replay is named — keep a manual save from before Randy's final mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Follow Tyrone's missions to their end and the trophy pops at the finale; save before that last mission, since the description names one mission and no replay is named. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Final mission of a stranger strand (Tyrone). The description names a single mission and no replay is named — keep a manual save from before Tyrone's final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots are the quiet viewpoints scattered over the map — reach one, meditate there, and it counts; all 18 earn the trophy. Spots stay visitable after the story, so take your time and sweep them in the cleanup phase. PSN tracks the count to 18. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the 18-spot count.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret is one of the strangers, so his strand starts when you meet him — follow it until the hunt is offered, track the animal down, and take it. Because the description names one specific hunt, treat it as a one-shot and save before the hunt in case it cannot be repeated. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: A single named hunt for a stranger (Bret). The description names one unique animal and no repeat is named — save before the hunt.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — pick them up as you explore, and a set counts when every card in it is found. Three finished sets earn the silver; there is no deadline, so sweep for cards in the cleanup phase. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. Each new location counts once, so keep moving — a hundred distinct spots, not a hundred uses in one place. It is a slow burn that pairs well with exploring the map for the other collectibles. PSN tracks the count to 100. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the 100-location count.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges span driving, combat, exploration and activities, so the count grows as you play everything else — check the challenges menu to see what is close, and finish 50 of any kind. Nothing here is missable. PSN tracks the count to 50. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the 50-challenge count.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. The trick is the escape, not the stars: break line of sight, get out of the search area, and stay hidden until the wanted level clears — with your partner still beside you when it drops. It can be retried freely. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level alive between them. Plan a route through three nearby shops, hit them one after another without letting the heat drop, and do not get caught — if the wanted level clears or you are busted, start the run over. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles — drive them, ride in them, or spot them around Leonida and they count toward the total. Variety is the whole game here: try everything from scooters to trucks to boats, and the count climbs as you explore. Nothing here is missable. PSN tracks the count to 100. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the 100-vehicle count.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Set it up: find a fight with at least five enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and clear all five before it ends. If you run out of targets, let the fight reset and try again — it can be retried as often as you like. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from the Vice City International Airport — leave VCIA in a way the airport did not schedule. This is a hidden trophy whose description names a single airport moment, so treat it as a one-off: when you are at VCIA, look for the way out that is not a normal flight, and save before you try it. No verified walkthrough exists yet — this is our reading of the official description. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Hidden trophy: a single unscheduled departure at the airport (VCIA). The description names one moment and no repeat is named — save before attempting it.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description points at Rhinos — the tanks — and a moment hot enough to earn a trophy. This is a hidden trophy with a cryptic description, so no verified method exists yet: expect a tank-related set-piece or a Rhino encounter, and keep a save from before any story moment that puts you in or against a tank. Our reading of the official description only. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Hidden trophy: the description names a single tank (Rhino) moment and no repeat is named — keep a save from before any Rhino set-piece.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get away without ever being detected — no alarms, no witnesses, no wanted level during the job. Plan the approach, move quietly, and leave before anyone raises the alarm; if you are spotted, the attempt fails and you start over, so a clean run is the whole trophy. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Vault robberies are the big jobs: plan the entry, grab the cash, and get clear before the response arrives. Five successful escapes earn the silver, and vaults can be retried, so a failed job costs nothing but time. PSN tracks the count to 5. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the 5-vault count.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape with the cash. Trucks run routes around Leonida — stop one, get inside, take the money, and break away before the police box you in. It is a single job, retriable, so set it up carefully and drive off clean. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida — all 52 areas. The map fills in as you visit each named area, so drive, fly and walk the whole state: the city, the swamps, the keys and the countryside. It pairs naturally with the other exploration trophies (vehicles, meditation spots, WAiNK locations), so sweep it during cleanup. PSN tracks the count to 52. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the 52-area count.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the nine gangs in Leonida. Each gang runs its own operations — find one per gang, hit it, and get away. Nine gangs, nine robberies; the operations stay available after the story, so work through the list during cleanup. PSN tracks the count to 9. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the 9-gang count.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — a quiet story-scene moment on the beach. This is a hidden trophy whose description names one specific scene, so treat it as a one-off: when the story brings you to Ocean Beach, take the cocktail and the view, and keep a save from before the scene. No verified walkthrough exists yet — this is our reading of the official description. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Hidden trophy: a single cocktail scene on Ocean Beach. The description names one moment and no repeat is named — keep a save from before the scene.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic style — drive straight through the glass and out the front. This is a hidden trophy tied to one showroom moment, so treat it as a one-off and save before any mission that puts you in a showroom. No verified walkthrough exists yet — this is our reading of the official description. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Hidden trophy: a single showroom smash-out. The description names one moment and no repeat is named — save before any showroom mission.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — bowl there and finish the frame. This is a hidden trophy tied to one bowling alley, so head to the Kolt & Associates alley and play a full game; if the trophy does not pop at once, finish the game properly rather than quitting early. No verified walkthrough exists yet — this is our reading of the official description. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Hidden trophy: a single moment at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The description names one place and no repeat is named — save before your first game there.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — a hidden trophy whose description is deliberately vague, so no verified method exists yet. It reads like a story moment about the duo's partnership landing with the public: play the story through and watch for a partnership beat that the game flags. Our reading of the official description only — check back once a verified guide exists. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Hidden trophy with a vague description. It reads like a single story beat about the partnership — keep saves through story turning points.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — for better or worse. This hidden trophy tracks the choices you make across the story, and PSN tracks a progress count to 500, so it is a long accumulation rather than one decision: keep playing, keep choosing, and the count climbs. Because choices cannot be unmade, treat it as missable in spirit: do not skip story choices, and keep saves at the big decisions. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the 500 count.
trophies.missableNote: Hidden trophy: story choices accumulate (PSN tracks a count to 500). Choices cannot be unmade — keep saves at the big story decisions.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed on a second attempt at something. This hidden trophy reads like a retry moment: fail a mission, challenge or event once, then succeed on the immediate second try. No verified method exists yet — this is our reading of the official description, and a natural failure followed by a clean retry is the safest way to chase it. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Hidden trophy: the description names a second attempt. If it is tied to one event, a retry may be the only chance — save before retry-heavy moments.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — a hidden trophy for witnessing something strange. It reads like a one-off world event or a bizarre encounter somewhere in Leonida: keep your eyes open while exploring, and when something odd happens, you will know it. No verified method exists yet — this is our reading of the official description. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Hidden trophy: the description names a single strange event. It may happen once — keep saves while exploring odd corners of Leonida.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a drive-by, swing the melee weapon as you pass, and connect: it is the bowling-alley trophy's rowdy cousin, so the Kolt & Associates alley is a natural place to try it. It can be retried in free roam. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.missableNote: Hidden trophy: a melee drive-by. The bowling connection suggests one place to try it, but the description names no mission — retry it in free roam.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from the big jobs — take them to your contacts, launder them, and the earnings add up toward $250,000. It is a slow accumulation tied to the crime path, so keep laundering as you rob. PSN tracks the amount to $250,000. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the $250,000 figure.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cars, clothes, weapons, food, everything counts toward the one total. There is no need to grind it: buy what you want as you play and the counter climbs. If you are close near the end, a big purchase tips it over. PSN tracks the amount to $100,000. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the $100,000 figure.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties across Leonida. Garages are the properties that store your vehicles — visit each one for sale, pay up, and own the set. They are bought with in-game money, so this pairs with the crime and laundering trophies that fill your wallet. PSN tracks the count to 8. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles for the 8-garage count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find or own ten vehicles, open the app, and register each one — ten registrations earn the trophy. It pairs with discovering 100 vehicles, so register the interesting ones as you find them. Sources: Exophase for the official description, PSNProfiles as the cross-check.
trophies.name: On the Spot
